tickets.subject: Add pagination to the search endpoint
tickets.description: Cursor-based paging on the search results so the grid stops loading every row at once.

tickets.subject: Fix the flaky checkout integration test
tickets.description: The checkout suite fails about one run in eight on CI; suspected race on the test fixture seed.

tickets.subject: Cache the pricing API responses (5-min TTL)
tickets.description: Memoize the upstream pricing calls with a short TTL to shave p95 latency on the quote page.

tickets.subject: Paginate the audit log view
tickets.description: The audit log loads every event at once; page it so the table opens instantly.

tickets.subject: Add dark-mode tokens to the design system
tickets.description: Define the missing dark-surface and on-surface tokens so the theme stops falling back to light.

tickets.subject: Rate-limit the public webhook endpoint
tickets.description: Add a per-client token bucket so a noisy integration can't flood the ingest queue.

tickets.subject: Validate the CSV import schema
tickets.description: Reject malformed import rows up front with a clear per-column error instead of failing mid-load.

tickets.subject: Stream large exports instead of buffering
tickets.description: Stream the export to the client so a big report no longer pins a whole worker in memory.

tickets.subject: Add a health-check probe to the worker pool
tickets.description: Expose a liveness endpoint per worker so the orchestrator can recycle a stuck process.

tickets.subject: Add idempotency keys to the payment webhook
tickets.description: Dedupe retried webhook deliveries so a double-send can't charge or refund twice.

tickets.subject: Add retry and backoff to the email worker
tickets.description: Retry transient send failures with exponential backoff and a dead-letter after five attempts.

tickets.subject: Debounce the autosave on the editor
tickets.description: Coalesce rapid keystrokes into one save so the editor stops hammering the API on every key.

tickets.subject: Tighten the rate-limit response headers
tickets.description: Return standard RateLimit headers so clients can back off before they hit the wall.

tickets.subject: Invalidate the CDN cache on publish
tickets.description: Purge the edge cache when content is published so readers stop seeing the stale version.

tickets.subject: Sanitize filenames on upload
tickets.description: Strip path separators and control characters from uploaded names before they touch disk.

tickets.subject: Migrate the session store to Redis
tickets.description: Move sessions off the single-node cache so a deploy no longer logs everyone out.

tickets.subject: Compress avatars on upload
tickets.description: Resize and re-encode avatars at upload so the profile grid stops shipping multi-MB images.

tickets.subject: Backfill the analytics events table
tickets.description: One-off backfill of the events table so the new dashboard has history to chart.

tickets.subject: Index the orders table on customer id
tickets.description: Add the missing composite index so the orders-by-customer query stops doing a full scan.

tickets.subject: Dedupe duplicate webhook deliveries
tickets.description: Drop deliveries that repeat a delivery id within the window so consumers see each event once.
